title: Agent definitions follow-up: registered copy on the Automation record and the first real core definition
description:
**Problem.** PPY-68abaa (closed) delivered the definition file format, but `core/` holds only `.gitkeep`: no real core definition exists. Its line 'the Automation record becomes the registered copy (id, version, digest)' was dropped without a note. Closed early; filed here, not reopened.

**Change.** Add the registered copy of a definition (id, version, digest on the Automation record), and the first real core definition (the rating agent's file) so applying definitions by release has something to apply.

**Acceptance criteria**
- The Automation record carries the registered copy: definition id, version and digest.
- Applying a definition twice with the same digest changes nothing; a changed digest bumps the version.
- At least one real core definition exists under `core/` (draft for the rating agent, declaring `acted` or `nothing`, never proposing five stars).
- PPY-df3e74 (D2) lists the registered-copy line in its own acceptance criteria.

**Critical path (board edges, added with this task).** PPY-e95a0c and PPY-0d4984, then PPY-1b2edd, then PPY-df3e74 must be blockers of the schedule trigger (PPY-2a53cd) and the rating agent (PPY-d85860). Start e95a0c and 0d4984 now; they conflict with nothing in flight.

**Gherkin features needed**
- agent-definition-registered-copy.feature: 'applying a definition records its digest and version'; 'applying an unchanged definition changes nothing'; 'a changed definition bumps the version'.

**Dependencies:** blocks PPY-df3e74 and PPY-d85860. Relates PPY-68abaa.

**Report:** papyrus-track-report-1.md, section 1 (#1630 row; follow-ups 3), section 4 critical path table, page one row 4.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Built and merged to develop (PR #1644). The Automation record carries the registered copy: definitionId, definitionVersion, definitionDigest and definition (fields only, no new model or resource). register() in agent_definitions/registered.py writes nothing for an unchanged digest, version 1 first, next version on a changed digest, and touches nothing else. core/rate.yaml is the first core definition (bulk tier, daily, never five stars, never publishes, operations at the operation-table rung, no rung set). Specs: agent-definition-registered-copy.feature, rating-agent-definition.feature. Not done: creating Automation records and applying by release (D2, PPY-df3e74, must list the registered-copy line in its acceptance; the design doc line was added), the rating procedure (L1), and a rating-write operation in the operation table (none exists).
